note: Family-run river outfitter and campground on the Niobrara near Sparks, operating since 1974; a busy tubing/kayaking put-in with designated party areas plus quieter wooded/family sections. Some sites on the riverbank, others on a 10-ft embankment above. No ATVs or UTVs allowed. --Claude
summary: Operator camping page read today: $12/adult + $15 electric per site (+tax), $39 for two adults (matches stored fees; an 8/2026 RV Life review quotes the same rates), season May 1 - Oct 15. Fees and season now manual. The site says nothing on site counts, amperage, showers or reservations, so those stay derived. Private gate passes ($39; website + phone; Google 4.3/52; RV Life 8.0/5). Water: riverfront -> riverview suggested (camp roads run along the bank). Sand: no open-beach driving seen; unpaved sandhill tracks.
flags: WATER (downgrade suggested, riverfront -> riverview): on NAIP the camping areas sit behind the camp's own roads. West of the landing a dirt track follows the bank with only a ~10 m grass strip between it and the water, and the wooded campsite clearings are north of that track; east of the landing the terraced camping area is north of the main river road, which runs along the bank. The Niobrara is ~70-100 m wide here (riverfront class, not creekside). I could not pick out RV or electric sites as such, and the operator posts no site map. A view of the river from the camping areas is supported (8/2026 RV Life motorhome review: 'Was beautiful, very close to the river'). Unsure, so down.

SAND RULE: nothing on the operator's pages or in reviews describes driving onto sand or beach, and there is no ReserveAmerica listing (no 'Driveway Surface'). The camp roads and clearings are unpaved, pale sandhill soil on NAIP; reaching the sites does not involve an open beach. Not a candidate as I read it.

PRIVATE GATE: rate $39 for two adults with electric ($12/adult + $15/site + tax; operator page undated, 8/2026 review corroborates) - under $50. Presence: operator website with phone (402) 376-2506 (stored) / (402) 322-5606. Ratings: Google 4.3 from 52; RV Life 8.0 from 5 (under 25). Long-stay tests: nightly per-person camping at a tubing outfitter, no monthly rates or residents - passes all five.

PARTY CHARACTER (inclusion, judgement for AWH): RV Life 7/2018 fifth-wheel review [5]: 'Be careful with this one. It's party central Thursday night through Sunday afternoon. 500 tubing reservations on the third Saturday in July.' 8/2026 [8]: 'Only complaint was the out house was very old and gross. Smelled really bad.' The operator does sell drive-in nights with electric hookups (motorhome on pull-through site 26 in 8/2026; fifth wheels in 2016/2018), so it qualifies; the party weekends are worth knowing.
HOOKUPS: the page sells an 'Electric Hookup $15 per Site' but states no amperage; none written. A 10/2020 reviewer called it 'Easy to find and hookup'.

UNVERIFIED (derived, left): sites.count 140, showers/flush toilets, reservable by phone - none of these appear on the operator's pages. A 10/2020 review says 'the shower house was closed ... We only had a concrete toilet no flush' (October, off-season).
PIN OK: stored 42.87328,-100.26223 is at Sharp's Landing/office, between the west and east camping areas (each within ~300 m).
